svg.title: cargo_box 1 in XPS foam board at 1x, mm, XPS foam board 8 x 4 ft — sheet 2

g.text: 200 mm — if this bar does not measure 200 mm, the page has been rescaled
mountain fold — crease towards you, panels away
valley fold — crease away, panels towards you
Marked side faces OUT; mountain and valley are named as seen from it. Glue tabs fold under, to the inside. This is an open surface, so which face is out comes from the model's own winding and
cannot be checked — a bowl and a dome are the same triangles. If it is inverted, every fold is inverted together: hold one panel against the model before creasing the rest.
